text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 2. Scanned copy of valid passport information page (valid for at least 4 years). With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 3. Certificate of Non-criminal Record The content of the certificate must indicate the expiration date, or if there is no expiration date, the certificate should be valid for 6 months from the date of issue; Graduating students in China can submit a certificate of school performance. If you are unable to provide the Certificate of Non-criminal Record for the time being due to various special circumstances, please fill out theNo-criminal Commitment. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 5. Scanned copies of the originals of the highest degree certificates. Degree certificates obtained overseas shall be notarized, with scanned copies of the notarial certificates submitted. Recent graduates shall be issuedPre-graduation Certificate by their colleges and shall, after being admitted, submit the originals of the degree certificates and the scanned copies of the notarial certificates. * 6. Scanned copies of the originals of transcripts for all courses at the highest academic level. Recent graduates can provide existing transcripts and resubmit all transcripts upon admission. * 7. Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors. * 8. Financial Support Guarantee Statement You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Personal Statement or Study Plan More than 800 words in Chinese or English. * 10. 3-5 minute self-introduction video The video should include the following 1. Self-introduction 2. Understanding of China 3. Study plan in China * 11. Supervisor acceptance letter for international students of Xidian University Please contact our supervisors in advance to gain the letter and upload it to the application system. You can download a template or sample from here . * 12. Record of medical examination for foreigners Valid for 6 months from the date of issue. You can download a template or sample from here . 13. Other supporting documents. Eg.recommendation letter, certificates of awards, certificates of paper publication, etc. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
